verbal_intervention.headline: FOMC DELIVERS THE HIKE: +25bp to 3.75-4.00%, 12-0, first increase since July 2023, 'more tightening ahead' + dot plot pencils one more this year - Warsh bucks Trump into the vote
verbal_intervention.source: Federal Reserve FOMC statement Sep 16 14:00 EDT (12-0 vote) / Reuters 'Fed hikes in search of timelier drop in inflation, sees more tightening ahead' (Howard Schneider, Sep 16) / CNBC 'signals one more to come this year' / Bloomberg 'Fed Raises Rates as Warsh Bucks Trump' - fresh
verbal_intervention.summary: The 'no-win vote' resolved as the hike-over-objection branch: FOMC raised 25bp to 3.75-4.00% on a unanimous 12-0 vote, first hike since July 2023, with the dot plot pencilling another increase this year and the statement framing 'timelier' inflation progress. Warsh's presser upheld credibility-forward positioning ('Warsh's credibility is on the line' resolved as hawkish delivered). The president's explicit objection was overridden - the independence collision now moves to aftermath phase (fiscal-dominance optics + Trump retaliation risk into the next meeting).

verbal_intervention.summary: The hike landed WITH the collision intact rather than resolved: every wire frames it as defiance (AP 'defies Trump', Bloomberg 'bucks Trump'). CNN live-blog carries the debt-problem warning about the president. Trump's retaliation channel into the next FOMC (pressure campaign, appointee-voting-against-president optics) remains open - fiscal-dominance tail risk persists now that the first override succeeded.

verbal_intervention.headline: Yen breaks to 156-level day-1 post-hike: joint-intervention gains FULLY unwound and exceeded; Bessent defends 'nominal'/'modest' US role in joint yen-buying to Congress

Bessent spent the window defending the Treasury's 'nominal' participation in Congress as 'modest' cost, 'supports American exports' - a US official openly endorsing a weaker-yen posture while the intervention unwinds. BOJ decides Friday with the pair at 156 into the decision.

Two-sided posture: the channel is open (de-escalation-leaning) but the war's kinetic track (Mecca, Red Sea coast) kept running in parallel - treat as channel-open evidence, not confirmed turn.
